added_failures_note: derived from the reviewed run's own arm logs under existing-regression/: baseline-suite.log at 3dbf01a8d2ef and after-suite.log at dd5aa7cd55e3 each carry ten completed FILE_RECEIPT lines and a SUITE_RECEIPT with failure_count 2 and the identical pair ['tests/biot/test_kernel_compile_cost.py::test_point_jet_expression_bound','tests/test_biotpolygonmoments.py::test_flux_moment_expansion_point_translation_identity']; the ten JUnit files per arm each contain exactly two failing testcases. The after-minus-baseline set difference is empty (0).

findings.text: non-blocking: `if xp is jnp and not field_derivatives` bypasses `_packed_moments_with_stable_height` whenever a JAX caller also requests the derivative outputs, so such a call silently loses the stable-pole tangents and the sixth-order corner-height Richardson samples that custom_jvp exists to supply; no shipped call site passes the flag today and test_compiled_field_derivative_outputs uses generic far-from-corner targets, so the combination is unguarded.

non-blocking: plan section 8 names this file as the section's record and the node declared it as a write path, but it is absent from the delivered diff, so the plan-facing record of the measurements does not exist; the numbers themselves are durably held in the gate logs and the manifest.

non-blocking: `assert relative < 1e-10` compares the jitted evaluation against an eager call of the same function, so both sides move together and any error in the derivative arithmetic passes; it guards compilation parity only, which is its stated purpose, but it contributes no coverage of the values under test.

non-blocking: `np.testing.assert_array_equal(rows[:9], _rows(points, geometry))` compares the same function with the flag on against the flag off, so it can only hold that the new flag leaves rows 0:9 untouched and cannot catch a wrong base row, because both sides would be wrong together.

non-blocking: the shipped test mutates its own output through the ambient environment variable NOVA_FIELD_DERIVATIVE_SIGN_FLIP, so any process or CI job that carries that variable set runs a deliberately false assertion and reports a red gate that names no defect in the code.

item_verdicts.call_sites: verified 3 production call sites, all of which call packed_analytic_moments without field_derivatives and so keep the nine-row path unchanged
item_verdicts.diff: read 2b721b6ad, 2ee8f45e8 and dd5aa7cd5 against base 3dbf01a8d2ef; two files, +453/-3, being the new _field_line_integral/_field_line_moments boundary reduction plus the field_derivatives branch in _packed_analytic_moments_primal and a new 255-line test module.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when's three clauses map one-to-one onto tests/biot/test_field_derivative_outputs.py:226 (lowering ratio bound with a counts[0] > 1000 known-present control), :195-:209 (200 generic and 50 corner-height targets against sixth-order central differences) and the NOVA_FIELD_DERIVATIVE_SIGN_FLIP arm at :144, and scoped-gate-1795419223220932605.log records 10 passed EXIT=0 with ratio 1.468, generic 2.17e-11 and corner-height 2.06e-9.
item_verdicts.goal: plan section 8 asks the packed kernel to return d_r Br and d_z Br per moment order as primal outputs of the same edge contour reduction; nova/biot/polygonanalytic.py:3626-3640 appends the two triplets from the existing contour accumulation inside _packed_analytic_moments_primal, and nova/biot/polygonanalytic.py:3624 returns the original nine rows untouched when the flag is off.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it reports status complete at head dd5aa7cd5, 15-row/9-row instruction counts 31719/21605, generic 2.1738626871940731e-11 and corner-height 2.0643076666778661e-9 worst agreement, and a sign-flip negative control red at EXIT=1; every one of those figures matches the log files it names.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared paths are nova/biot/polygonanalytic.py, tests/biot/test_field_derivative_outputs.py, the evidence fragment under docs/evidence/fragments/kernel-compile-barrier/ and a figures directory; the diff touches only the first two and both are inside the fence, so the change stays within scope while leaving the named evidence fragment undelivered.

justifications.durability: tests/biot/test_field_derivative_outputs.py:209 compares the new derivative rows against a sixth-order central difference of the existing field rows, an independent quantity, and negative-control.log shows that assertion red by id at EXIT=1 with maximum_relative=2.0000000000002442 when the output sign is flipped.
justifications.evidence: scoped-gate-1795419223220932605.log records 10 passed EXIT=0 at revision dd5aa7cd5 with FIELD_DERIVATIVE_LOWERING nine_rows=21605 fifteen_rows=31719 ratio=1.46813238 and the per-cohort agreement bounds, while the paired arms record 190 passed, 2 failed, 13 skipped and 1 xfailed in each arm with identical failing ids.
justifications.fit: the additions follow the module's own idiom as set by horizontal_flux_line_moments at nova/biot/polygonanalytic.py:925 (untyped nested helpers, mechanism docstrings, vertex.across/plain primitives) and introduce no version, plan or stage label, though the test carries an environment-variable mutation hook.
justifications.goal_fidelity: nova/biot/polygonanalytic.py:3626-3640 appends d_r Br and d_z Br as three rows each, in the same unit/radial/vertical order as the field rows, from the same boundary-reduction pass rather than by differentiating the kernel.
justifications.reuse: the diff extends the packed primal reduction instead of forking it, reusing range_function/total/scaled/product, vertex.plain, vertex.across, vertex.against_first_arsinh, edge._second_residual, _oscillatory_primitive and _edge_residual_band; a search of nova/biot for prior analytic primal field-derivative machinery found none, since _central_field_moments_direct and polygon_analytic_field_moments are the NumPy reference path, not the packed JAX reduction.
justifications.scope_discipline: the two paths in the diff, nova/biot/polygonanalytic.py and tests/biot/test_field_derivative_outputs.py, are both inside the declared write paths and nothing else was touched.
